layout.tagline: Chefs and home cooks near you

client.subject: Request {ref} sent to {chef}
client.preheader: {chef} has 48 hours to reply to your request.
client.heading: Request sent to {chef}
client.lead: Hello {name}. Your request is on its way and {chef} has 48 hours to accept it, decline it or suggest another date.
client.depositLater: You pay nothing yet. If {chef} accepts, we will ask you for a deposit to confirm the date; the rest of the price is arranged directly with the chef.
client.payChef: You pay nothing yet: payment is arranged directly with the chef.
client.footnote: Keep this email: the link above is how you open your request and talk to the chef, without creating an account.

chef.subject: New request {ref}: {offer}
chef.heading: You have a new request
chef.lead: Hello {name}. {client} has sent a request and is waiting for your reply.
chef.footnote: You have 48 hours to accept, decline or suggest another date. After that the request expires on its own.

reviewRequest.subject: How did it go with {chef}?
reviewRequest.heading: How did it go with {chef}?
reviewRequest.body: A review takes ten seconds: just choose the stars. Your review helps other people choose, and only people who have completed a booking can write one.
reviewRequest.footnote: You have 14 days to leave a review.

ibanChange.subject: Confirm the change to your IBAN
ibanChange.heading: Confirm your new IBAN
ibanChange.lead: You asked to receive your payments into an account ending in {last4}.
ibanChange.confirm: Open the link below to confirm. Until you confirm, payments keep going to your previous account.
ibanChange.validity: The link is valid for one hour and only works while you are signed in.
ibanChange.notYou: If this wasn't you, don't open the link and contact us immediately: your account may have been compromised.
ibanChange.footnote: Once confirmed, payments are held for 72 hours for security.

nudges.notAgain: If you have changed your mind, just ignore this email. We won't remind you again.

noProfile.subject: Your Ao Lume page is still to be created
noProfile.preheader: Creating the account took two minutes; the page is still missing.
noProfile.heading: {name}, your page doesn't exist yet
noProfile.lead: You created your account but never got round to creating your profile, so nobody can find you yet.
noProfile.body: You'll need the name you want to show, the area where you cook and a sentence about yourself. Photos and menus can come later.

draftIncomplete.subject: Your page needs photos and a menu before it can go public
draftIncomplete.preheader: Your profile is created; what clients see is still missing.
draftIncomplete.heading: {name}, you're nearly there
draftIncomplete.lead: Your profile exists, but it doesn't yet have what clients need to see before requesting a booking.
draftIncomplete.body: It still needs three photos of dishes and at least one menu with a price. That is what decides who books and who closes the page.

draftReady.subject: Everything's ready: just send your profile for review
draftReady.preheader: One button between you and your first requests.
draftReady.heading: {name}, one button to go
draftReady.lead: You have photos, you have a menu, and your profile still hasn't been sent for review.
draftReady.body: Our team reviews every profile before it goes public. After that you start appearing in searches in your area.

support.subject: We have received your message · {ref}
support.heading: We have received your message
support.lead: We usually reply on the same working day.
support.addMore: If you need to add anything, reply to this email and mention the reference.
support.complaints: You can also use the Complaints Book (Livro de Reclamações): {url}

signup.subject: Your Ao Lume account has been created

chef.preheader: The next step is to create your chef profile.
chef.heading: Your chef account has been created
chef.lead: {hello} The next step is to create your profile: three steps, about ten minutes, and the team reviews it before it goes public.

client.preheader: You can now look for chefs near you.
client.heading: Welcome to Ao Lume
client.lead: {hello} Your account has been created. You can now look for chefs near you and make your first request.

receipt.subject: We have recorded your acceptance
receipt.heading: We have recorded your acceptance
receipt.lead: {hello} On {when}, you accepted {list}. Keep this email: the links below open the exact text you accepted, which you can save and print.

reference.subject: Reference for the deposit · booking {ref}
reference.preheader: Reference to pay the deposit for booking {ref}
reference.heading: Details to pay the deposit
reference.lead: You can pay through online banking or at a Multibanco cash machine.
reference.body: The booking is confirmed automatically as soon as the payment comes in.

depositDue.subject: Deposit due · booking {ref}
depositDue.preheader: The deposit for booking {ref} is due
depositDue.heading: {chef} has accepted your request
depositDue.headingNoName: The chef has accepted your request
depositDue.lead: The deposit still needs to be paid for the booking to be confirmed.
depositDue.howToPay: You can pay by MB WAY or by Multibanco reference on the booking page.
depositDue.restToChef: The rest of the price of the service is arranged with and paid directly to the chef.

client.subject: Booking {ref} confirmed
client.heading: Deposit received, booking confirmed
client.leadNoName: The chef already knows everything is confirmed.
client.owed: Still to pay the chef, on the day
client.dateSecured: The date is secured. {chef} will arrange the rest of the price with you, which is paid directly to them on the day of the service.
client.dateSecuredNoName: The date is secured. The chef will arrange the rest of the price with you, which is paid directly to them on the day of the service.
client.keep: Keep this email: the link below opens the booking and your conversation with the chef.

chef.subject: Deposit received · booking {ref}
chef.heading: The deposit is in
chef.body: We transfer this amount once the service is completed, with the payment document.

payout.subject: Payment {amount} · {ref}
payout.heading: We've paid you
payout.body: The document with the detailed breakdown is in your dashboard, under Payments.

confirm.subject: Confirm your email
confirm.preheader: One more step to activate your Ao Lume account.
confirm.heading: Confirm your email
confirm.lead: Hi{name}. To activate your Ao Lume account, please confirm this email address is yours.
confirm.footnote: If you didn't create an Ao Lume account, you can ignore this email: without confirmation, the account stays inactive.

recovery.subject: Choose a new password
recovery.preheader: The link to change the password of your Ao Lume account.
recovery.heading: New password
recovery.lead: We received a request to change the password of your Ao Lume account. Use the button below to choose a new one.
recovery.footnote: The link works only once and expires shortly. If you didn't ask for this, ignore this email: your password stays the same.
